page.overview:
Who is Crumble?

Crumble of the Construction Patrol doesn't know his own strength. He desperately whishes to create and preserve beauty, but he often damages and destroys such things by accident. His teammates often resort to saying stuff like, "Uh, no, it looks better that way. Really. Very Neo-Brutalist".

Crumble was one of the legions of Dead Universe Micromasters who pursued Hardhead and Nightbeat on Gorlam Prime. He survived to pursue the Autobots into the planet's subterranean caverns, and helped the Jhiaxus-possessed Nightbeat dig out after Hardhead triggered a cave-in.

Crumble transforms into a gray crane truck of undetermined model. He was only available in a four-pack with his teammates Groundpounder, Neutro and Takedown.
